new_axioms.name: Experimental.P03_08.laplace_density_hasDerivAt
new_axioms.meaning: For every natural k and positive tau,y, the displayed infinite exponential density has the displayed termwise tau derivative.
dependencies: Termwise parameter differentiation and convergence of the actual exponential series
new_axioms.supports: 3.8(2) moment differentiation, not the determinant/Jacobi target

new_axioms.name: Experimental.P03_08.laplace_moment_local_domination
new_axioms.meaning: For every actual admissible tuple p, every moment order e and positive tau0, an epsilon<tau0 and one integrable majorant dominate the actual moment and its proposed derivative uniformly on that neighborhood.
dependencies: Definition 2.1 denominator polynomials and actual p
Exponential-tail estimates, rational-weight polynomial growth, local integrability at zero
new_axioms.supports: 3.8(2) dominated parameter integration; no determinant formula is an assumption

scope: The exact displayed Laplace series and actual D_N(y^2)^(2m)/D_K(y^2) rational weight are defined. The two new inputs support parameter differentiation of moments only. The determinant derivative and CD spectral identity remain targets.
missing_interfaces_and_limits: The definition uses the paper's odd-weight Laplace normalization, with the zeta evaluation point to remain fixed. No existing unimported ChristoffelDarboux or LaplaceJacobiIdentity candidate is imported. Missing interfaces: tau=1 density identification, measurability, deformed moment measure/Gram, actual monic orthogonal polynomials and integral squared norms, CD inverse-Gram identification, pole operator, characteristic polynomial comparison, and matrix logarithmic derivative assembly. The two analytic inputs deliberately support only part (2); part (1) starts from the imported actual positive Gram and algebraic slope facts.
discharge_policy: Replace each new axiom by proof of the identical quantified statement; compile and audit each changed module and its dependent graph. Never merge axiom-dependent conclusions into certified main. A proof consuming a new axiom is conditional experimental work, not new A-Tier evidence.
